reasons: Funds of $162,968 are short of the $171,768 needed; $53,000 in gifts can't be used because the donor or property type isn't allowed.

final_answer:
DTI: 32.07% (B3-6-02) — within limit.  
LTV: 75% — eligible.  
Funds to close: $171,768. Available: bank $162,968 + gift $53,000 = $215,968.  
Reserves: 11.98 months — no minimum for 1-unit principal residence (B3-4.1-01).  
Credit: 717 — meets 620 minimum.  
No bankruptcy/foreclosure.

Gift donor is an "interested party." B3-4.3-04 prohibits personal gifts from interested parties (builder, developer, real estate agent, or any other interested party). The $53,000 gift cannot be used as a personal gift. Without it, the borrower has $162,968 but needs $171,768 — short $8,800. The gift could be reclassified as an IPC (B3-4.1-02), but IPCs may only cover closing costs ($15,518), not down payment; the excess would be a sales concession requiring price reduction. The file presents it as a gift with a gift letter, not an IPC.

DECISION: decline  
RULES: B3-4.3-04
